note: A guard: when life is low, the character takes much less damage from hits for a few seconds (the absorb limit is folded into a flat reduction), then waits for the cooldown.

def.name: Iron Hide
def.description: A guard: for a few seconds you take much less damage from hits.

note: A guard: for a few seconds the character takes less damage from hits (the share absorbed and reflected as fire is folded into the reduction).

def.name: Slag Carapace
def.description: A guard: a shell of slag that blunts the next hits.

note: A guard cast when life is low: for a second the character takes much less damage, longer and with much less physical damage for each Grit charge it spends (up to five). It waits three seconds, and other guards wait with it.

def.name: Deathless Call
def.description: A guard: a call that keeps you standing for a moment, and for longer, with much less physical damage, for each Grit charge you spend.

note: A buff kept up while enemies are near: faster attacks and life leech (the life drain and frenzy charge on kill are dropped).

def.name: Surge of Blood
def.description: Your blood runs hot: faster attacks that leech life.

note: A buff cast when a pack or a rare enemy is near: more attack damage, speed and movement, and less damage taken (the rage threshold and loss are dropped).

def.name: Rampage Call
def.description: A fury that makes you hit harder and faster and take less.

note: A blink: the character jumps toward a target that is out of reach (cooldown 2 seconds).

def.name: Quick Step
def.description: A short jump toward your target.

note: A blink toward the target (the burning ground left behind is dropped).

def.name: Cinder Step
def.description: Vanish in a flash of fire and land close to your target.

note: A blink toward the target (the chilling ground and the cooldown recovery from nearby enemies are dropped).

def.name: Rime Step
def.description: Step through the frost and land close to your target.

note: A warp toward the target (the shocking markers it leaves are dropped).

def.name: Bolt Step
def.description: Become lightning and arrive next to your target.

note: A blink toward the target (the corpse and the explosion it triggers are dropped).

def.name: Shadow Swap
def.description: Swap places with a shadow of yourself close to your target.

note: A buff of movement speed and more melee physical damage, kept up in fights.

def.name: Slipstream Run
def.description: A burst of speed that makes your melee blows hit harder.

note: A buff of movement speed that leaves the enemies near open to chaos (the withered stacks are folded into chaos penetration; the dash is dropped).

def.name: Rotting Stride
def.description: A stride that rots the ground you cross and leaves enemies open to chaos.

note: A leap to the target that lands in a slam; stuns enemies on full life.

def.name: Skyfall Leap
def.description: Leap to a target and slam down on it.

note: A charge with a shield to the target that hits harder the farther it ran.

def.name: Bulwark Rush
def.description: Charge at a target behind your shield. Needs a shield.

note: A whirling dash through the target, hitting once along the way.

def.name: Spinning Dash
def.description: Spin through your target with your weapon out.

note: A spinning attack around the character that builds up speed (the stages and the slower movement are averaged).

def.name: Twister Blade
def.description: A spin that sweeps everything near, faster the longer it lasts.

note: A strike that carries the character to the target. It waits two seconds between uses, unless a Fervour charge is spent; it gains Fervour charges on hit, attacks faster for each, and speeds the character for three seconds after each use.

def.name: Blinking Cut
def.description: Vanish and strike. It waits two seconds between uses, unless you spend a Fervour charge; each charge quickens it, and each use speeds you for three seconds.

note: A dash through the target that ends in a lightning burst (the stages while channelling are averaged).

def.name: Storm Rush
def.description: Rush to the target and burst in lightning.

note: A travelling attack that is half fire and leaves holy ground behind (the ground is dropped).

def.name: Blessed Trail
def.description: Run to the target in a trail of fire and strike.

note: A hooked strike that reaches far and gains rage when it hits.

def.name: Snag Lash
def.description: A hook that reaches far and feeds your rage.
